work.note: The survey and primary bibliography identify French En attendant Godot publication in 1952. The companion separately dates the first performance to 1953; English editions are 1954/1956.

description: Retells both acts of Waiting for Godot and analyzes their repeated appointment, precarious friendships, verbal play, physical comedy, and refusal of conventional dramatic progress.
